_comment: 30 hand-written questions to the Official Records engine, each with the behaviour an answer owes. The verifier's own list of 30 (2026-10-01: 14 answered well or declined honestly, 6 fell back silently to the site's records for an author outside the 706-person register, 10 wrong in one of the ways of tests VI-EN-1 to VI-EN-5) was not kept in the repository; only five of its questions are quoted (in tests/historian/verify-ingest-engine.test.mjs). This file is a reconstruction of the same thirty in kind: those five, their variants, and questions of the other two groups written by hand against the text (every anchor below was read in the normalised OCR of the document it names, not taken from an engine answer). Origin 'verifier' = the question is quoted by the verifier; 'reconstructed' = written for this file. Classes: wrong = a class the verifier found wrong, answered = a question the engine answered well or declined honestly, outside = an author the site's registry does not hold. Fields of expect (all optional): mode (answer | partial), quotes {min,max} (corpus quotes), quote_any (every regex matches at least one quote), quote_all (every quote matches), no_quote (no quote matches), text (every regex matches the answer text), not_text (none matches), clock_day (every clock claim inside a quote is of this day).
